about: Which Wikidata item each multi-component ChEMBL target is - every PROTEIN COMPLEX, PROTEIN COMPLEX GROUP and PROTEIN FAMILY, and the SINGLE PROTEIN ChEMBL files against several accessions - for scripts/resolve_cohort_wikipedia.py. No identifier reaches these (a member's accession walks to a superfamily), so the identity is written down by hand after review: the item, never the article title, which is still resolved from the item when the backfill runs (CLAUDE.md invariant 15). A null item is a target that was reviewed and has no article of its own, with the reason.
rule: The narrowest English article that covers the whole target and is about that receptor, channel, enzyme, family or complex. A subunit combination takes the article of the receptor it is a form of (GABA-A alpha-1/beta-2/gamma-2 takes GABAA receptor). Never a structural superfamily, a protein domain, a disambiguation or set-index page, or one subunit's own article - that is the subunit's link, not the assembly's.
reviewed: 2026-10-18, against ChEMBL 37 under selection policy cohort1-selection v3.5.0
